summary: Brookfield Wealth Solutions, a Bermuda-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form -6K attaching its November 11, 2026 press release reporting third-quarter 2026 results (the US equivalent of an earnings release furnished on Form 8-K). Figures: total assets $203.851bn versus $152.821bn; distributable operating earnings $519m and $1.445bn for the three and nine months, up from $427m and $1.262bn; net income $863m and $410m; EPS $0.07 and $0.21, split-adjusted. Highlights include $4bn of annuity sales, over $8bn deployed into Brookfield strategies at roughly an 8% target yield, and continued Just Group optimization. No transaction terms, board recommendation or advisor named; no special-situation event to arbitrage.
